changes: Added the execution-plan decision document docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md (~701 lines). It specifies the default REVIEW path, the automatic 3x2 escalation trigger (firstReviewRound.countableProblems >= 2), the always-on decision-doc 3x2 rule, true host/session/key/signature/material independence, stale-digest rejection, the read-only vs mutating artifact split, the process-fact registry wiring, rollout, a test matrix with adversarial negative controls, and acceptance criteria. Documentation-only; no code change.
usage: Read docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md as the authoritative plan before implementing the 3x2 review-escalation gate; the File-Level Execution Plan and Acceptance Criteria sections drive the follow-up implementation story.
expectedOutcome: A reviewer/implementer finds a complete, standalone execution plan at the documented path covering escalation trigger, independence requirements, artifacts, CLI surface, rollout, tests, and acceptance criteria.
actualTranscript: Doc present and readable at the promised path (701 lines); delivery reviewer verified 7/7 documented promises via grep against the file; validate allPass=true with 6/6 intent items covered; cli-e2e story-lifecycle + gap-convergence passed. See evidence/transcript-diff.md.
outcomeDiff: No diff — the delivered document matches the planned scope and the checklist promise.
limitations: Planning artifact only — it documents the 3x2 escalation gate design but does not implement it; the implementation lands in a separate follow-up story.
pitfalls: When implementing from this plan, do NOT count reviewer independence by hostId alone — the plan requires hostId + sessionId + keyId/identityDigest + payload signature + material binding, and rejects stale head/material/validation digests.
